name: dotnet-xunit
xUnit v3 (.NET 8.0+); v2 migration: `IAsyncLifetime` returns `ValueTask`, `[ClassData]` uses `TheoryDataRow<T>`, assertion message parameters removed. Run [skill:dotnet-version-detection]. Related: [skill:dotnet-add-testing], [skill:dotnet-testing-strategy], [skill:dotnet-integration-testing], [skill:dotnet-snapshot-testing].

Use `[Fact]` for unparameterized tests; `[Theory]` with `[InlineData]`, `[MemberData]`, or `[ClassData]`. `IClassFixture` shares resources within a class; `ICollectionFixture` shares across classes. Collections run sequentially internally and in parallel with other collections. Configure `xunit.runner.json`; copy with `<Content Include="xunit.runner.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />`. Enable `xunit.analyzers`; `.editorconfig`: `dotnet_diagnostic.xUnit1004.severity = suggestion`.

**Do not disable parallelism globally.**
**Do not use constructor-injected `ITestOutputHelper` in static methods.**
**Do not forget to make fixture classes `public`.**
**Do not mix `[Fact]` and `[Theory]` on the same method.**
**Do not return `void` from async test methods.**
**Do not use `[Collection]` without a matching `[CollectionDefinition]`.**
`xUnit2002`: Do not use null check on value type.
`xUnit2007`: Do not use `typeof` expression to check type.
`xUnit2013`: Do not use equality check to check collection size.
`xUnit2017`: Do not use `Contains()` to check if value exists in a set.
